Description: The working title of the application.
One-sentence pitch (what the app does in plain language).
The single most important action a user should take in the app.
Who the app is being built for (role / industry / size).
The specific pain point this app addresses.
What makes this app unique compared to competitors.
How the app generates revenue (subscription, one-time, transactional, etc.).
Plan names and price points if applicable (e.g., Free, Pro $29/mo, Enterprise).
Happy-path summary in 1–3 sentences (sign up → do X → get Y).
All distinct roles in the system (e.g., admin, merchant, customer).
How users log in (email/password, OAuth provider, magic link, SSO).
Third-party services the app must connect to (Shopify, Stripe, Twilio, etc.).
Nice-to-have integrations that can be added later.
Framework/library and language (e.g., React + TypeScript + Vite).
Framework/runtime and language (e.g., Node.js + Express).
Database engine (e.g., MongoDB, Postgres, Firestore).
ORM, queue, cache, search, etc. if relevant.
Where the app runs (Vercel, AWS, Render, Fly, etc.).
Production URL or planned domain if known.
Features explicitly NOT to be built in this version.
Compliance, performance, browser, or budget constraints.
How success is measured (DAU, MRR, conversion %, etc.).
Estimated complexity (Simple / Intermediate / Advanced).
Anything else the AI agent should know before generating code.
